visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up shot of a stack of golden-brown brown sugar glutinous rice cakes topped with red goji berries. The background is a blurred studio kitchen setting with neutral, bright lighting. Yellow variety-style text appears at the top. (2) A male chef in a white professional uniform with pink floral details on the sleeves and collar is standing behind a kitchen counter. He holds two transparent bowls filled with white glutinous rice, one long-grain and one round-grain. He pours them into a large metal pot. (3) A close-up reveals the dry rice in the pot as clear liquid (rice wine) is poured from a glass measuring cup. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The scene transitions to the rice steaming inside a white electric rice cooker. Steam is visible around the lid. Text overlays explain the cooking time. (5) The cooked white rice is shown in the pot, looking sticky and glistening. The chef uses a red silicone spatula to stir and lift a portion, demonstrating its texture. (6) Various ingredients are added to the cooked rice: longan meat, red powder, brown sugar, and clear oil. The chef uses the red spatula to thoroughly mix the ingredients until the rice turns a uniform dark brown color. (7) The dark rice mixture is transferred into a rectangular metal tray lined with plastic wrap. The chef uses the spatula to press it down flat and even. He then picks up the tray and drops it onto the wooden counter several times to remove air bubbles. (8) The final product is shown as square-cut pieces of the cake, garnished with bright red goji berries on top, presented in a clean, bright studio environment.
